items.title: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap with update path that won't break your build
items.excerpt: At Unite Seoul, Unity detailed Unity 7, its next-gen authoring platform built around AI-driven authoring — a new CLI, public API and a free MCP that let coding agents observe, act on and verify a live project alongside developers and artists.

items.title: At SIGGRAPH, NVIDIA Advances Graphics and Simulation With Agentic and Physical AI
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's SIGGRAPH 2026 rollup spans neural rendering, world models and MotionBricks — a real-time motion model trained on 350,000+ clips that lets creators direct and connect character movements at game-engine speed for games, film and robots.

items.title: NVIDIA Graphics Research Accelerates Simulation & Physical AI Through 21 Breakthrough Technologies at SIGGRAPH
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's 21 accepted SIGGRAPH 2026 papers are becoming the foundation of real-time systems that generate 3D-grounded, physics-governed virtual worlds directed by creators — spanning neural rendering, materials and world models applicable to game production.

items.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Hands Over Full Control To Artists To "Direct The Final Frame"
items.excerpt: A SIGGRAPH technical demo shows DLSS 5's neural rendering going beyond upscaling into AI image synthesis — taking a game's color and motion vectors and letting artists direct photoreal lighting and materials in real time at 4K.

items.title: "Steam's required AI disclosure is the right move": Devs say gen AI should be called out in games and support Valve's store mandate
items.excerpt: Developers push back on Tim Sweeney's criticism of Valve's AI labels, arguing disclosure of generative AI content shipped to players is a baseline transparency and creative-credit issue that other storefronts should adopt.

items.title: Steam Week in Review: more than half of new Steam games will have an AI-disclosure by 2027-2028
items.excerpt: A census of Steam releases finds 30.8% of 2026 games now carry an AI disclosure, up from 10.9% in 2024, with the trajectory pointing at a majority of new releases labelling generative-AI content within two years.

items.title: NVIDIA Brings Local AI Agents To Its DGX Station Workstation With The NVIDIA Agent Toolkit & Omniverse
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's Agent Toolkit lets DGX Station users run personal AI agents locally in about 30 minutes, combining Nemotron models and Omniverse libraries so agents can access tools and skills in a secure on-device runtime for creator and dev workflows.

items.title: Meshy Wants AI for 3D Creation to Feel More Like a Creative Partner
items.excerpt: Meshy has opened its new 3D Agent beta to all users — the first fully conversational, multi-step AI agent built for 3D creation. It keeps context across a chat so game artists can brainstorm, generate style-consistent asset families, and export rigged models straight into Blender, Maya, Unreal, Unity, Godot and Roblox pipelines.
